findings.title: No host or admin can save an event: database error 'null value in column maps_url of relation event_locations violates not-null constraint'
findings.note: save_event_location inserts a row with only plan_id, but event_locations.maps_url is NOT NULL and no migration relaxes it. Fails even with a valid Maps link. Everything after it (approve, go live) cannot be reached from the UI. Check whether the original database was patched by hand (drift).

findings.title: Admin dashboard lists an inactive event as 'Active' and counts it in 'Active events'
findings.note: The Event library shows it under Inactive, so the two screens disagree.

findings.title: A past real event never offers the next date
findings.note: 'Next date' looks up events with the same key, but every real event has its own unique key (x<id>), so only the old sample plans could ever show it. Product decision needed.
